data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'finis', meaning 'end' or 'boundary'. In Christian context, Fine can symbolize being morally and spiritually sound, and a good example of virtue and beauty. This name is often used for girls who are considered delicate, pleasing, and fair. The name Fine carries the meaning “Delicate, pleasing, fair” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fine usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, pleasing, fair and live with faith, good character and purpose.
